title: lnkiai/m3e-canvas: sketch the screen, then hand the agent a prompt.
friendlyTitle: Sketch the phone screen, then give the agent a prompt
summary: M3E Canvas is a browser tool for sketching Material 3 phone screens and turning them into prompts for a coding agent. It gained 101 stars on GitHub's daily TypeScript trending list and has about 10,500 stars overall. The sketch stays in the browser. The license is MIT.
friendlySummary: M3E Canvas is a browser tool for drawing phone screens and turning them into prompts for a coding agent. It gained 101 stars on GitHub's daily TypeScript list and has about 10,500 stars in all. The sketch stays in the browser. The license is MIT.
whyItMatters: Use it when you want a coding agent to build a screen that already has a layout, instead of describing the buttons from memory. The prompt is not the app. Open the result and check the taps, the text, and the empty states before you ship it.
